product: Add Lakewatch folders from existing schemas
tagline: In Lakewatch, Add folder can now register an existing schema as a folder, so you no longer need CREATE SCHEMA on the catalog to add one.
what_it_does: In Lakewatch, Add folder can now register an existing schema as a folder, so you no longer need CREATE SCHEMA on the catalog to add one. You can also delete a folder from Settings Environment. Beta Lakewatch is in Beta.
why_it_matters: To set up least privilege access for a security team, follow Set up Lakewatch access control.
plain_summary: In Lakewatch, Add folder can now register an existing schema as a folder, so you no longer need CREATE SCHEMA on the catalog to add one. You can also delete a folder from Settings Environment.

capabilities.title: CREATE CATALOG on the metastore
capabilities.desc: CREATE CATALOG on the metastore, to create a new catalog. The Recommended configuration creates a new catalog.
